title: Criteria attack record
description: Record of one attack round over a document's acceptance criteria: the revision attacked, which lenses reported, the objections they raised, and how each was adjudicated.

spec_path.description: The attacked document, which this record is committed beside. A bare filename: the record's own directory is the only one searched, so a path leading out of it names a document no attacker in the round read.

spec_revision.description: Revision of the document this round attacked.

lenses.description: One entry per lens that reported, empty reports included. A lens that errored or returned unreadable output has no entry, and the round is unfinished.

objections.description: The union of the lens reports. Each objection carries the id its disposition names.

revision.description: Content-addressed revision of the document: sha256: followed by the hex digest of its bytes, or the 40-hex object id of the same content. Written with no surrounding whitespace — git hash-object ends its output with a newline, which the pattern above does not catch and the checker refuses.

id.description: Identifies this objection to its disposition. Assigned when the lens reports are unioned, and distinct within the round: dropping a malformed objection renumbers positions, so a disposition keyed on position would adjudicate a different objection after the edit.

lens.description: The attack lens that produced this objection.

target_ac.description: Identifier of the criterion attacked, or "none" when no criterion covers the ground at all.

ground.description: The rule of the acceptance-criteria standard that the criteria as written break.

hole.description: What the criteria as written let through.

red_test_sketch.description: The scenario that shows the objection. All three parts are required and non-blank: an item that cannot name a starting state, an action, and an observable outcome is a concern rather than a testable claim, and is not an objection.

id.description: Id of the objection this adjudicates.

revision.description: Revision of the document that carries an accepted objection. Required on an acceptance, different from the revision attacked, and the same on every acceptance in the record: the document reached one state once all of them were in it, so per-acceptance revisions name states it was never in and the check refuses the round.

covering_ac.description: Identifier of the criterion in that revision which answers the objection, written by the document's author. Required on an acceptance.

disposition.description: Each verdict carries the fields that make it an adjudication: an acceptance the revision and criterion that now carry the objection, a rejection the reason it was not taken.
